key_insight: An asymmetrically threaded SQUID (ATS) coupler enables fast entangling gates that preserve Kerr-cat qubits’ protection against bit-flip errors.
engineering_relevance: The proposed coupler could support concatenated cat-qubit architectures by enabling entanglement without sacrificing the noise bias needed for efficient error correction.
method: Use an ATS parametric coupler to entangle Kerr-cat qubits.
Engineer unequal photon numbers in control and target modes to suppress non-adiabatic leakage without complex pulse shaping.
Evaluate the bias-preserving CX gate through full-circuit Hamiltonian simulations.
evidence_signal: Simulations report 99.69% CX fidelity in 50 ns without photon loss and a noise bias of 9922 at a 100 kHz single-photon loss rate, approximately 570 times the naive non-bias-preserving CX baseline.
watch_item: The results are numerical; experimental performance remains to be established under realistic device imperfections and additional noise channels.
paper_title: Bias-Preserving Entanglement of Kerr-Cat Qubits with an ATS Coupler
